title: Page 9
slug: 捡夫宝娘子-金妍-戚家四兄弟只剩他戚无双这个当家老大还未娶妻-看弟弟们恩爱成双加上每天被媒婆们当大肥羊紧盯著-他烦不胜烦
content_zh:
“我虽然不知道你们夫妻之间到底发生了什么事，但你能追到这里来真的很有心。”
“我相信总有一日你绝对能如愿以偿的……”
“非常感谢各位。”他一面答谢，一面想着从明天开始，他要私底下安排一群人固走向安儿买包子，只要不让她知道那群人是他找来的，她就不会生气。
宝安儿在一旁看着，真是感到不是滋味，他故意公开两人之间的夫妻关系，是想怂恿其他人来一起逼迫她回家吗？他想都不要想！
她不会轻易低头认输的，她一定要坚持下去，决不能被他的奸计打败！
稍晚，宝安儿和贵叔收摊回家之后－－
“小姐，你还想和姑爷呕气到什么时候呀？”
厨房里，贵叔正帮着宝安儿处理做肉包的馅料，忍不住还是问了，如果可以，他真的很希望小姐能早点和姑爷回家，别再倔强，硬是要赌气到底。
他相信姑爷是有心想求得小姐的谅解，他也相信两人只要误解讲开来就会没事，偏偏小姐还在赌气，不想和姑爷说话，也难为姑爷不计较，愿意继续等待下去，等大小姐终于肯面对他为止。
“贵叔，连你也站在他那边？”宝安儿气恼地扁起嘴。“既然如此，那你就去找戚无双好了，别留在我这里。”
她承认，自己的确有些赌气，毕竟她之前因他的不信任伤透了心，也吃足了他的硬钉子，现在他终于明白自己的错误，希望能带她回去，她如果轻易地就和他回去，不是太便宜他了？
她的气还没消，才不想太早原谅他，至少得再让他多吃一些苦头，让他深切的体认到，她可不是个逆来顺受的小妻子，她也是有脾气的。
“好好好，我不说就是了，小姐别气、别气。”贵叔赶紧住嘴，就怕自己越帮姑爷说话，反而越是帮倒忙，这样可就不好。
但他私心还是偏向姑爷那边，所以明着帮姑爷说话不行，那……那他就改别的方法好了，希望这件事情可以赶紧落幕呀……
结果，贵叔反倒变成埋伏在宝安儿这边的“内奸”，宝安儿的一切状况，戚无双都能透过贵叔知道，这对戚无双来说无疑是一件好事。
但对宝安儿来说，确实糟糕极了！
“安儿，贵叔今天怎么没有陪你出来买做包子的材料？不如我陪你吧。”
宝安儿才一出门，过没多久就被戚无双这个半路杀出的程咬金给缠上了，她没好气地瞪着他，他依旧满脸笑意，不把她的冷脸当一回事。
贵叔是刚才临出门前才说自己肚子痛，没法跟她一起出来买东西，怎么好死不死他就出现了？她不得不怀疑，肯定是贵叔在内神通外鬼！
她不想理他，自己一个人往前走，戚无双也就亦步亦趋地跟着，和她比看谁的耐性比较够。

宝安儿进到面粉铺，老板看到宝安儿和后头跟进的戚无双，马上笑道：“戚公子，还没得到你家娘子的原谅呀？”
“老板要帮我说好话吗？如果真能哄得我家娘子愿意跟我回家，我肯定包份大礼感谢老板。”面对老板的调侃，他倒也自在地回应。
“哈哈，我哪有这种本事呀，你的大礼我大概是无缘收下了……”
他们两人的事情已经传得满城的人都知道，不管走到哪里，都会有人认出他们俩，戚无双是不怎么在乎，倒是宝安儿始终感到非常的尴尬及不自在。
“老板，我要一大袋面粉。”她只想早点买完早点离开，免得老是会被人问“你什么时候才要原谅你家相公呀”，她都快被问得烦了。
老板将一袋沉重的面粉放到柜台上，宝安儿付完帐之后伸手要拿，结果戚无双快了她一步，率先抱起面粉袋，不让她拿。“这面粉很重，还是我来帮你吧，别拒绝我，好吗？”
他绝不允许她做这么粗重的工作，她的倔强不但会累了自己，还会让他的心跟着难受，所以无论如何，在这个节骨眼上他是不会让步的。
“是呀，戚夫人，这么重的东西不是女人家该拿的，还是让你家相公帮你吧。”
老板也乐得做个顺水人情，免得他们直接在他的店里吵起来，只为了这么一丁点的小问题。
宝安儿没好气地瞧了戚无双一眼，也不和他争，直接转身离开铺子，他如果真要在她的身边当苦力，那就当吧，她为什么要和自己过不去？
戚无双跟着追出去，不屈不饶地继续跟着。
宝安儿在热闹的市集中穿梭，戚无双紧跟在后，免得跟丢她的行踪，突然一名男子在拥挤之间从后撞了宝安儿一下，连道歉都不说就继续往前走，连瞧都没瞧她一眼。
“哎呀！”宝安儿吃痛地皱起眉，感到原本放着钱袋的袖袋似乎变得空空的，赶紧伸手一探，才发现钱袋不见了。“糟糕，那可是我辛苦赚来的钱呀！”
她气愤地瞪着前方快步离去的男子背影，不甘心地追上去。“停下来，把钱还给我！”
小偷看宝安儿已经察觉且快追上了，赶紧迈开步伐逃跑，和她在人群中互相追逐起来。
“安儿！”戚无双担心她在冲动之下会发生什么危险，把手中的面粉袋随便搁置在一旁，连忙追上。“别追了，钱再赚就有，自己的安全要紧！”
宝安儿一心只想着要追回自己辛苦赚来的钱，根本就没听进戚无双的话，拼命追着小偷。“别跑，你这个小偷！”
第9章(2)
小偷拐进一条小巷道里，巷道的边墙堆了不少杂物，看到后头宝安儿还是不放弃的追进巷子里，他在情急之下将靠在墙边的竹竿木板使力推倒，断了她追过来的路。
宝安儿看着众多竹竿木板朝她的方向倒过来，一时吓得失去反应，眼看竹竿木板就要打到她身上了。

“安儿，危险！”戚无双从后头冲上来，赶紧将她紧抱在怀，扑倒在地，用自己的身体保护她。
“啊－－”宝安儿惊呼出声，一瞬间就被他压倒在地，紧接着许多东西砸下的声音此起彼落，吓得她不敢睁开眼。
等到东西掉落的声音停止后，她才睁开眼，焦急地微偏过头，担心地问：“无双，你还好吗？”
他们俩现在一起被压在交错的竹竿木板之下，但她却毫发无伤，因为戚无双替她挡去所有伤害，东西全都打在他的背上。
她担心得红了眼眶，没想到事情会变成这样，早知如此，她就不会冲动地追着小偷不放，害无双替她受苦了。
“我没事。”戚无双的背虽然疼痛难耐，甚至头也因为被敲击到而有些晕眩，却还是努力地撑起身子，免得她被压伤。
但他右肩后强烈的刺痛感，让他逐渐使不上力，双手撑得非常辛苦，宝安儿也察觉到他的异样，担心他受了伤却不告诉她。
“无双，你……”她讶异的瞧着他撑在她身旁的右手，从衣袖内竟然流出一条血痕到手背，惊慌得几乎要哭出来。“你受伤了！”
“只是小伤，不碍事……”他硬是咬牙撑住，但他却不敢想，自己到底还能撑多久。
“你不要再骗我了，都流出血来了，怎么会不碍事？”她终于哭出声来，痛心他为了保护她而受伤。“你再忍一忍，会有人来救我们的，你一定不会有事的！”
她好害怕，害怕会因为这场意外失去他，她虽然和他赌气，却依然深爱着他，不愿意他受到任何伤害呀！
content_en:
"Although I don't know what happened between you and your wife, I'm really grateful that you came here to pursue me."
"I believe that one day you will definitely get what you want..."
"Thank you all very much." As he thanked him, he thought that starting from tomorrow, he would privately arrange for a group of people to go to An'er to buy buns. As long as she didn't let her know that he had found those people, she wouldn't be angry.
Bao An'er looked on and felt really uncomfortable. Did he deliberately disclose the relationship between the two of them as husband and wife? Did he want to encourage others to force her to go home? Don't even think about it!
She will not bow her head and admit defeat easily. She must persevere and never be defeated by his tricks!
Later, after Bao An'er and Uncle Gui closed the stall and went home -
"Miss, how long do you want to be angry with my uncle?"
In the kitchen, Uncle Gui was helping Bao An'er with the fillings for making meat buns. He couldn't help but ask, if possible, he really hoped that the young lady could go home with her uncle as soon as possible, and stop being so stubborn and insisting on being angry to the end.
He believed that the uncle wanted to ask for the lady's forgiveness, and he also believed that as long as the misunderstanding between the two people was resolved, everything would be fine. However, the lady was still angry and did not want to talk to the uncle, which was why the uncle did not care and was willing to wait until the eldest lady was finally willing to face him.
"Uncle Gui, are you even on his side?" Bao An'er pursed her lips angrily. "In that case, then go find Qi Wushuang and don't stay here with me."
She admitted that she was indeed a little angry. After all, she had been heartbroken by his distrust before and had suffered from his hard nails. Now he finally understood his mistake and hoped to take her back. If she went back with him easily, wouldn't it be too easy for him?
She was still angry, so she didn't want to forgive him too early. She had to at least let him suffer a little more, so that he could realize that she was not a submissive little wife, and she also had a temper.
"Okay, okay, I won't say anything. Miss, don't be angry, don't be angry." Uncle Gui quickly shut up, fearing that the more he spoke for his uncle, the more he would be unhelpful, which is not good.
But his selfishness still favors his uncle, so if he can't speak for his uncle obviously, then... then he should try another method. I hope this matter can be brought to an end soon...
As a result, Uncle Gui turned into a "traitor" ambushing Bao An'er. Qi Wushuang could know all the conditions of Bao An'er through Uncle Gui, which was undoubtedly a good thing for Qi Wushuang.
But for Bao An'er, it's really terrible!
"An'er, why didn't your uncle accompany you to buy the materials for making steamed buns today? How about I accompany you."
As soon as Bao An'er went out, she was soon entangled by Qi Wushuang, Cheng Yaojin, who came out halfway. She glared at him angrily, but he still had a smile on his face and didn't take her cold face seriously.
Uncle Gui just said before going out that he had a stomachache and couldn't go shopping with her. Why did he show up when he was so lucky? She had to suspect that Uncle Gui must have magical powers inside and out!
She didn't want to pay attention to him and walked forward alone. Qi Wushuang followed suit, competing with her to see who had more patience.
Bao An'er entered the flour shop. When the boss saw Bao An'er and Qi Wushuang following behind, he immediately smiled and said, "Mr. Qi, haven't you received your wife's forgiveness yet?"
"Boss, do you want to put in a good word for me? If I can really coax my wife to come home with me, I will definitely give you a big gift to thank the boss." Faced with the boss's teasing, he responded comfortably.
"Haha, how can I have such ability? I probably didn't have the chance to accept your gift..."
Everyone in the city knew about the two of them. No matter where they went, someone would recognize them. Qi Wushuang didn't care much, but Bao An'er always felt very embarrassed and uncomfortable.
"Boss, I want a big bag of flour." She just saidShe wanted to finish shopping and leave early, so as not to be asked all the time, "When are you going to forgive your husband-in-law?" She was almost tired of being asked.
The boss put a heavy bag of flour on the counter. After Bao An'er paid the bill, she reached out to take it. However, Qi Wushuang was a step ahead of her and picked up the flour bag first, preventing her from taking it. "This flour is very heavy, so let me help you. Don't refuse me, okay?"
He would never allow her to do such heavy work. Her stubbornness would not only tire him out, but also make his heart feel uncomfortable, so no matter what, he would not give in at this juncture.
"Yes, Mrs. Qi, such a heavy thing is not something a woman should carry. You'd better ask your husband-in-law to help you."
The boss was also happy to be a favor and prevent them from starting a fight in his store just for such a minor issue.
Bao An'er glanced at Qi Wushuang angrily, and turned around and left the shop without arguing with him. If he really wanted to work as a coolie by her side, then so be it. Why should she be at odds with him?
Qi Wushuang chased him out and continued to follow unyieldingly.
Bao An'er was walking through the busy market, and Qi Wushuang followed closely to avoid losing her whereabouts. Suddenly, a man bumped into Bao An'er from behind in the crowd, and continued walking forward without even apologizing, without even looking at her.
"Oops!" Bao An'er frowned in pain, feeling that the sleeve pocket that originally held the money bag seemed to be empty. He quickly reached out to check, only to find that the money bag was missing. "Oops, that's my hard-earned money!"
She glared angrily at the back of the man who was walking away quickly, and chased after him unwillingly. "Stop and give me the money!"
Seeing that Bao An'er had noticed and was about to catch up, the thief quickly ran away and chased her through the crowd.
"An'er!" Qi Wushuang was worried that she might be in danger if she acted impulsively, so he put aside the flour bag in his hand and hurriedly caught up with her. "Stop chasing after you. As long as you make money, you'll have it. Your own safety is more important!"
Bao An'er only wanted to recover his hard-earned money, and didn't listen to Qi Wushuang's words at all, chasing the thief desperately. "Don't run, you thief!"
Chapter 9(2)
The thief turned into a small alley. There was a lot of debris piled up on the side wall of the alley. When he saw Bao An'er behind him, he still didn't give up and chased her into the alley. In desperation, he pushed down the bamboo poles and wooden boards leaning against the wall, blocking her path to pursue.
Bao An'er saw many bamboo poles and planks falling in her direction. She was so frightened that she lost her reaction. She saw that the bamboo poles and planks were about to hit her.
"An'er, it's dangerous!" Qi Wushuang rushed up from behind, hugged her tightly, threw her to the ground, and used his body to protect her.
"Ah -" Bao An'er exclaimed, and was instantly pushed to the ground by him. Then the sound of many things falling down came one after another, scaring her so much that she didn't dare to open her eyes.
After the sound of things falling stopped, she opened her eyes, turned her head slightly anxiously, and asked worriedly: "Wushuang, are you okay?"
The two of them were now pressed together under the intertwined bamboo poles and wooden boards, but she was unscathed because Qi Wushuang blocked all injuries for her, and everything hit his back.
Her eyes were red with worry. She didn't expect things to turn out like this. If she had known it would happen, she wouldn't have impulsively chased the thief and caused Wushuang to suffer on her behalf.
"I'm fine." Although Qi Wushuang's back was in unbearable pain and even her head was a little dizzy from being hit, she still tried hard to hold herself up to prevent her from being crushed.
But the strong tingling sensation behind his right shoulder gradually made him unable to use his strength, and it was very hard to hold it up with both hands. Bao An'er also noticed something strange about him and was worried that he was injured but would not tell her.
"Wushuang, you..." She looked at his right hand holding her side in surprise. A blood streak flowed from the sleeve to the back of his hand. She was so panicked that she almost cried.Come. "You're hurt!"
"It's just a minor injury, nothing to worry about..." He gritted his teeth and held on, but he didn't dare to think about how long he could hold on.
"Don't lie to me anymore. He's bleeding. How can it be okay?" She finally cried out, feeling sad that he was hurt trying to protect her. "If you bear with it a little longer, someone will come to save us. You will be fine!"
She was so scared, afraid that she would lose him because of this accident. Although she was angry with him, she still loved him deeply and didn't want him to be hurt in any way!
